scope: Owned-app mobile layout and purchase-plan generation interaction fixes. No new original-ERP equivalence claim.
observed_defects: At 390px the persistent sidebar reduced the usable document area to about half the screen.
Generation relied on hover-based nested menus and pointerleave closed them for touch pointers.
No selected plan produced only a transient toast; a disabled generation button did not explain the preview step.
Input toolbars exposed many small buttons and plan validation messages could scroll out of view.
changes: Mobile submenu disclosure with explicit close, Escape and navigation close; desktop sidebar remains visible.
A tap on plan generation opens the setup dialog immediately. Without prior selection, eligible plans are shown unselected.
Preview is the initial primary action. Save appears only for a valid preview; success and errors stay in a separate dialog footer.
Phone document lists and plan candidate rows use cards; input auxiliary buttons fold into a two-column More section.
44px touch targets and fixed save actions at narrow widths.

targeted_regressions: Touch enter/click/leave opens and retains the generation dialog without a prior selection.
Preview/save visibility, missing supplier error location and duplicate-save prevention.
Mobile submenu close after navigation and Escape without closing work tabs.

local_browser.environment: Loopback Worker, local SQLite and synthetic app account; browser viewport override, not a physical mobile device.
local_browser.generation: Selected a synthetic plan with M001 quantity 2 and P002 quantity 1; preview split suppliers V001 and QA064V2; generated two orders and verified both in order list.
local_browser.layout: At 360px outer viewport, 345px document client width and 345px scroll width; four main tool buttons measured 44px high. At desktop, sidebar was block, auxiliary tools display contents and More was hidden.

not_verified: Physical phone touch, software keyboard and operating-system photo picker.
Hosted app login and purchase workflow with the user's live credentials.
Photo attachment failure location is awaiting user clarification. Existing item media supports HTTPS links, not direct file uploads.
